scope: A deliberately narrow AddModifier form: a catalog-defined modifier with supported catalog Stacking, no extra arguments except a static non-negative integral LifeTime, and the canonical ModifierOwnerEntity target alias.

selected_model.transition: The generic AddModifier executor creates or refreshes a pending ModifierInstance using the existing catalog Stacking model and persists the fixed LifeTime as current_life. It does not activate, tick, expire, or physically remove the instance at the AddModifier operation boundary.
selected_model.ordering: The existing Modifier lifecycle preserves TO_BE_ADDED at this boundary; activation, lifetime tick and dirty cleanup remain explicit later lifecycle transitions.
selected_model.target_rule: Only ModifierOwnerEntity is accepted; no inferred retarget or global modifier owner lookup is permitted.

local.support: PRIM-MODIFIER-001 defines current_life storage, ALIVE-only lifetime decrement and delayed dirty removal.

external.support: Three MoreOneMorePerTurn OnPhase1 callbacks carry the exact fixed LifeTime values 2, 3 and 4 for catalog-defined OneMore.

evidence.confidence: R4 lifecycle state model plus R3 pinned close-version canonical source payloads.

strict_rejection: missing modifier catalog definition or unsupported catalog Stacking
dynamic, fractional, negative or structurally extended LifeTime
Chance, DynamicValues, InheritCaster, AliveOnly, Layer, custom fields or any unrecognized AddModifier argument combination
all target aliases other than ModifierOwnerEntity
unsupported_boundary: This packet does not choose default stacking, lifetime, caster inheritance or global lookup policy.
It does not execute callback bodies or define the scheduler tick/event at which current_life changes.
It is not proof that all AddModifier operations or whole source BehaviorRecords are executable.

acceptance.expected: The three source components append pending OneMore instances with Merge stacking and current_life 2, 3 and 4 respectively.

dsh_implementation_contract: Accept this form only after schema validation. Preserve current_life on the pending instance and dispatch lifecycle activation/tick/cleanup through the shared modifier lifecycle rather than treating AddModifier as immediate activation or direct removal.
